summary: Iteration 2 focused on the new GST toggle logic, PDF variants (thermal/A4/A5), redesigned POS + mobile tabs + floating cart bar, quotation builder with validity dropdown / custom items / GST flip / convert, and WhatsApp share text. Backend: 24/24 pytest passed (12 new GST-focused + 12 updated smoke). Frontend: all requested flows functional; one CSS/positioning bug found on mobile floating cart bar (fixed element rendered outside viewport due to transformed ancestor becoming its containing block).

ui_bugs.issue: On viewport 390x844, .floating-cart-bar has computed position:fixed and bottom:16px but getBoundingClientRect returns top=1695 (viewport height 844) so it is rendered far below the fold and not visible without scrolling. An ancestor (likely one with transform / filter / will-change / contain in styles.css or a Framer/animation wrapper) is establishing a containing block for the fixed element, breaking viewport pinning. Click still works because Playwright dispatches events on the element, but real users on mobile will not see the bar.

design_issues.screen: WhatsApp share on POS with Walk-in customer
issues: window.open URL is https://wa.me/?text=... (empty phone) when no customer phone is set. Consider either disabling the button or falling back to store owner phone in that case.

action_items: Fix floating-cart-bar positioning on mobile: audit the ancestor chain for `transform`, `filter`, `will-change:transform`, `contain:paint/layout` or Framer Motion animate wrappers on the POS layout; either move the .floating-cart-bar out of that subtree (portal to body) or remove the transform so position:fixed truly pins to the viewport.

critical_code_review_comments: Mobile floating cart bar shipped with a CSS containing-block regression: even though styles.css applies position:fixed;bottom:16px, real DOM position is at y=1695 in a 844px viewport. Portal via createPortal(document.body) is the safest fix.

Backend/api_sales.py returns field name `discountAmount` in sale responses even though internal state includes only `overallDiscountAmount` — the naming duplication (`discount`, `discountAmount`, `overallDiscountAmount`) is a small DX trap; document or unify.

Held bills preserve draft.includeGst. Mobile floating-cart-bar has containing-block bug; verify after fix by evaluating getComputedStyle().position === 'fixed' AND getBoundingClientRect().top within window.innerHeight.
rca of the issue: CSS `position: fixed` on .floating-cart-bar is meant to pin to the viewport, but any ancestor with `transform`, `filter`, `perspective`, `backdrop-filter`, `will-change: transform`, or `contain: layout/paint` establishes a new containing block, causing the 'fixed' element to be positioned relative to that ancestor's box instead of the viewport. Confirmed with getBoundingClientRect().top = 1695.875 on a 844px-tall viewport while computed style still reports position:fixed. Fix: either strip the offending transform/contain on the ancestor, or render the floating cart bar via ReactDOM.createPortal(document.body).
